commitments.detail: Each activity will be scheduled within its allocated block to ensure the main generator supports the required load.
Each activity will be scheduled to the designated block as per the power control period.
Scheduled critical activities within available power control period without overlap.

The generator load test will be conducted from 0800-1000, followed by clinic refrigeration transfer from 1000-1200, communications-battery recharge from 1200-1400, and water-point pumping from 1400-1600.
